to.concept: any empirical construct in any lens

source: Carlson 1985, Nature 318:419, doi:10.1038/318419a0 (chance-level matching in a double-blind test)
scope: population-level only; never for converting one person's result
forbiddenUse: Frames have no relation to empirical constructs (M-6): no conversion, estimate or inference in either direction. Frame attributes and empirical results may be placed side by side for the person's own reflection, labelled as such.
